body.name: Signature-monotone selected graph
body.construction: For each \(\eta\in\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\), \(L_{A(\eta)}=(A(\eta),\{x\to y:xy\in H[A(\eta)],\ \sigma(x)\subseteq\sigma(y)\})\), with \(\operatorname{Reach}_{A(\eta)}(x,y)\) the nonempty directed reachability relation in \(L_{A(\eta)}\).
